"""Helper utilities."""
import re

def slugify(title):
    """Convert a title to a slug: lowercase, non-alphanumeric runs collapsed, no leading or trailing separators."""
    # Convert to lowercase
    slug = title.lower()
    # Replace non-alphanumeric characters with underscores
    slug = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '_', slug)
    # Strip leading and trailing underscores
    return slug.strip('_')
